Title: (LSJ) When cost is X, what happens ?

Messages.Author: François Alix
Messages.Body:
I want to play Minion Tap of 0 on any vampire. Can I ?
If I can't, must I play Hidden Strenght with a minimal cost of 1 ?
Thanks

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> I want to play Minion Tap of 0 on any vampire. Can I ?

Card Title: Minion Tap
Pool: n/a
Clan/Discip.: n/a
Card Type: Master
Card Text: Master
Move as much blood as you want from one of th
vampires you control to your blood pool.
Artist: Bryon Wackwitz
Rarity: Common

0 (zero) certainly falls within the realm of "as much blood as you want".
This is an oft used tactic when you don't have very much blood on any
of your vamps but want to cycle the MT out of your hand.

> If I can't, must I play Hidden Strenght with a minimal cost of 1 ?

You can pay 0 and prevent 1 damage with Hidden Strength. X is
the cost and 0 is a possible option (as would 1 or 2 or 3, etc.)

Sorrow

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"François Alix" wrote:
>
> I want to play Minion Tap of 0 on any vampire. Can I ?

You may choose to move zero blood from one of your controlled vampires, yes.

> If I can't, must I play Hidden Strenght with a minimal cost of 1 ?

You may play Hidden Strength with a cost of zero if you have 1 damage
(or more) to prevent.
